Subject: RE: Varnley Residential - New Submission

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the submission on Varnley Residential! I've reviewed the materials and everything looks good to move forward.

I have all the information I need - the application, statement of values, and loss runs are complete. I'll work up a quote for the January 3, 2027 effective date and aim to have something back to you within the next few business days.

The risk fits well within our appetite for residential properties at this value range. I'll do my best to come in competitively given your target premium expectations.

I'll be in touch soon with our proposal. Feel free to reach out if you have any questions in the meantime.

Best regards,

[Underwriter name]
